Image

class Image[source]

Bases: object

Utility class for loading, scaling and drawing images.

Supports physical paths and Qt resources (.qrc).

Attributes:
IMAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT_NAMEstr, class attribute

size value that keeps the original size (“default”).

IMAGE_CONVERT_ALPHA, IMAGE_CONVERT_BASEstr, class attribute

Pixel format conversion: convert_alpha() (“alpha”) or convert() (“base”).

IMAGE_POS_TOP_LEFT, IMAGE_POS_CENTERstr, class attribute

Anchor modes of draw (“top_left”, “center”).

IMAGE_POS_BOTTOM_CENTERstr, class attribute

Anchor mode of draw (“bottom_center”).

_cachedict, class attribute

Decoded and converted images (before scaling), by (path, conversion, flip). Avoids rereading the file/QRC every frame in Target.move and kill().

Methods

draw

Draw the image with different anchor modes.

load

Load an image (file or Qt), converted and scaled.

scale

Resize with smoothscale and a safe minimum size.
static load(img_name, size='default', convert='alpha', flip=False)[source]

Load an image (file or Qt), converted and scaled.

Parameters:
img_namestr

QRC alias, :/... path or file path.

size“default” | tuple[int, int], optional

Target size; “default” keeps the original size.

convertstr, optional

IMAGE_CONVERT_ALPHA (default) or IMAGE_CONVERT_BASE; any other value converts with alpha.

flipbool, optional

Mirror horizontally.

Returns:
pygame.Surface

A new surface (a copy, so callers may change it without affecting the cache); a magenta 32x32 surface if the image cannot be loaded.

Notes

Requires an initialized pygame display (convert). Errors are printed to the console, not raised.

static draw(surface, img, pos, pos_mode='top_left')[source]

Parameters:
surfacepygame.Surface

imgpygame.Surface

postuple[int, int]

Anchor position (x, y).

pos_modestr, optional

IMAGE_POS_TOP_LEFT (default), IMAGE_POS_CENTER or IMAGE_POS_BOTTOM_CENTER (case-insensitive).
